rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

assertingTests.name: Monk protection and Soldier safety stop the Imp (TB-MONK-01, TB-SOLDIER-01)
a healthy Monk's choice records one protection until dawn, its note and one secret log line (TB-MONK-01)
a new Monk choice ends the protection it gave before (TB-MONK-01)
a poisoned Monk protects no one and the Imp's attack kills (TB-MONK-01)
the Monk module declares a step for every night except the first (TB-MONK-01)
a healthy Monk returns one protection that ends at dawn (TB-MONK-01)
an impaired Monk reports a suppressed ability (TB-MONK-01)
